<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="第 1 页" id="t215mpw2doAh46O3Q51Z"> <mxGraphModel dx="3734" dy="2016" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant User as 用户
 participant Keyboard as 键盘控制器
 participant CPU as CPU / MMU
 participant TTY as tty 驱动
 participant Shell as Shell 进程
 participant Kernel as 内核 (sys_*)
 participant Pipe as 管道 Inode
 participant Scheduler as 调度器
 participant Disk as 硬盘驱动

 Note over User, Disk: === 第一阶段：键盘输入与 Shell 准备 ===

 User->>Keyboard: 按下 'l' 键
 Keyboard->>CPU: 触发 IRQ1 中断
 CPU->>TTY: keyboard_interrupt → do_keyboard_interrupt
 TTY->>TTY: put_queue 将 'l' 放入读队列
 TTY->>Scheduler: wake_up(&tty->secondary.wait) 唤醒 Shell
 TTY->>CPU: con_write 回显字符到显存 (0xB8000)

 Scheduler->>Shell: 调度 Shell (TASK_RUNNING)
 Shell->>Kernel: read(0, buf, count) → int 0x80
 Kernel->>TTY: sys_read → tty_read
 TTY-->>Shell: 返回字符 'l'

 Note over User, Disk: 重复按键，直到按下回车，Shell 得到完整命令行

 Note over User, Disk: === 第二阶段：Shell 解析命令并创建管道 ===

 Shell->>Kernel: pipe(fds) → int 0x80
 Kernel->>Kernel: sys_pipe → get_pipe_inode
 Kernel->>Kernel: get_free_page 分配环形缓冲区页
 Kernel->>Kernel: get_empty_filp ×2, get_unused_fd ×2
 Kernel-->>Shell: 返回 fds[0]=3 (读), fds[1]=4 (写)

 Note over User, Disk: === 第三阶段：创建 ls 子进程 ===

 Shell->>Kernel: fork() → int 0x80
 Kernel->>Kernel: sys_fork → find_empty_process → copy_process
 Kernel->>Kernel: get_free_page 分配 task_struct+内核栈
 Kernel->>Kernel: copy_page_tables (建立 COW，清除 R/W 位)
 Kernel->>Kernel: 复制 filp[], pwd, root, sigaction[]
 Kernel-->>Shell: 返回 ls 子进程 PID

 Note over Shell: Shell 继续执行，ls 子进程就绪

 Shell->>Kernel: fork() → int 0x80 (创建 grep 子进程)
 Kernel->>Kernel: sys_fork → find_empty_process → copy_process
 Kernel->>Kernel: copy_page_tables (COW)
 Kernel-->>Shell: 返回 grep 子进程 PID

 Shell->>Kernel: close(3) → sys_close (关闭管道读端)
 Shell->>Kernel: close(4) → sys_close (关闭管道写端)

 Note over Shell: === ls 子进程开始执行 ===

 Shell-->>Kernel: ls 子进程被调度 (TASK_RUNNING, eax=0)
 Kernel->>Kernel: dup2(4,1) → sys_dup2 (stdout→管道写端)
 Kernel->>Kernel: execve(\"/bin/ls\") → do_execve
 Kernel->>Kernel: namei(\"/bin/ls\") 打开可执行文件
 Kernel->>Kernel: flush_old_exec → free_page_tables 释放旧页表
 Kernel->>Kernel: change_ldt, do_mmap (建立虚拟映射，Present=0)
 Kernel->>Kernel: create_tables 构造用户栈
 Kernel->>Kernel: 设置 eip, esp → 准备返回用户态

 Note over CPU: 执行 ls 第一条指令触发缺页异常
 CPU->>Kernel: #PF (P=0, CR2 线性地址)
 Kernel->>Kernel: _page_fault → do_no_page
 Kernel->>Kernel: get_empty_page 分配物理页
 Kernel->>Kernel: read_page → bread → getblk
 Kernel->>Disk: ll_rw_block(READ) 启动 DMA
 Kernel->>Scheduler: wait_on_buffer → TASK_UNINTERRUPTIBLE → schedule()
 Disk-->>Kernel: 硬盘中断 hd_interrupt → end_request → wake_up
 Kernel->>Kernel: 数据复制到新页, put_page (Present=1)
 Kernel->>CPU: 重载 CR3, iret 返回
 CPU->>Shell: 执行 /bin/ls 代码

 Note over Shell: === grep 子进程开始执行 ===

 Shell-->>Kernel: grep 子进程被调度
 Kernel->>Kernel: open(\"output.txt\", O_CREAT|O_TRUNC) → sys_open
 Kernel->>Kernel: open_namei, new_inode, alloc_block
 Kernel-->>Shell: 返回 fd=3
 Kernel->>Kernel: dup2(3,1) → sys_dup2 (stdout→output.txt)
 Kernel->>Kernel: dup2(4,0) → sys_dup2 (stdin→管道读端)
 Kernel->>Kernel: close(3) → sys_close
 Kernel->>Kernel: execve(\"/bin/grep\") → do_execve
 Kernel->>Kernel: 类似 ls 的 flush_old_exec, do_mmap, create_tables
 Kernel->>CPU: 缺页异常 do_no_page 加载 grep 代码

 Note over Shell, Disk: === 第五阶段：ls 的执行 ===

 Shell->>Kernel: open(\".\") → sys_open → namei
 loop 遍历目录项
 Shell->>Kernel: getdents / read → minix_dir_read
 Kernel->>Disk: bread 读取目录数据块
 Disk-->>Kernel: 返回目录项
 Shell->>Kernel: stat(filename) → sys_stat → namei → cp_stat
 Kernel-->>Shell: 返回 struct stat
 end
 Shell->>Kernel: write(1, 格式化输出) → pipe_write
 Kernel->>Pipe: 数据写入环形缓冲区, PIPE_HEAD 移动
 Pipe->>Scheduler: 若管道满: interruptible_sleep_on → schedule()
 Pipe->>Shell: 唤醒等待中的 grep

 Note over Shell, Disk: === 第六阶段：grep 的执行 ===

 Shell->>Shell: regcomp(\"^d\") 编译正则
 loop 处理每一行
 Shell->>Kernel: read(0) → pipe_read
 Kernel->>Pipe: 从环形缓冲区取数据, PIPE_TAIL 移动
 Pipe->>Scheduler: 若管道空: interruptible_sleep_on → schedule()
 Pipe->>Shell: 唤醒等待中的 ls
 Shell->>Shell: regexec 匹配 '^d'
 alt 匹配成功
 Shell->>Kernel: write(1) → file_write
 Kernel->>Disk: bread / alloc_block, 标记 b_dirt
 end
 end
 Shell->>Kernel: pipe_read 返回 0 (EOF)

 Note over Shell, Disk: === 第七阶段：进程退出与回收 ===

 Shell->>Kernel: exit() → do_exit (ls)
 Kernel->>Kernel: free_page_tables, sys_close (管道写端, i_count=1)
 Kernel->>Kernel: 发送 SIGCHLD 给 Shell, state = TASK_ZOMBIE
 Kernel->>Scheduler: schedule() 切换

 Shell->>Kernel: exit() → do_exit (grep)
 Kernel->>Kernel: free_page_tables, sys_close (管道读端, i_count=0→释放管道页)
 Kernel->>Kernel: sys_close output.txt, iput 写回脏块
 Kernel->>Kernel: 发送 SIGCHLD, state = TASK_ZOMBIE
 Kernel->>Scheduler: schedule() 切换

 Shell->>Kernel: waitpid() → sys_waitpid
 Kernel->>Kernel: 查找 ZOMBIE 子进程, free_page 释放 task_struct
 Kernel-->>Shell: 返回子进程 PID 和退出状态

 Note over Shell, Disk: === 第八阶段：结果呈现 ===

 Disk-->>Disk: output.txt 脏块通过 bwrite 落盘
 Shell->>Kernel: write(2, 提示符) → tty_write → con_write
 Kernel->>TTY: 写显存, 更新光标
 TTY->>User: 显示提示符
